```{r}
library(tidyverse)
#system("git push origin main --force")

wd = "/Users/Hayden/CS526/" #Customize as needed
datapath = paste0(wd, "Data/")

#make sure IRS data is loaded in
irs_data = read_csv(paste0(datapath,"irs_migration_data_2012-2022.csv"))
totals = read_csv(paste0(datapath, "irs_data_totals_2012-2022.csv"))

irs_data = irs_data |>
  filter(!is.na(dist),
         sender_FIPS != receiver_FIPS) |> #lm() automatically removes missing data but maybe this speeds it up a tad
  mutate(instate = (sender_state == receiver_state))

cvap = read.csv(paste0(datapath, "final_with_CVAP_after_divide.csv")) |> #read in CVAP data
  mutate(fips = sprintf("%05d", county_fips)) |>
  select(-county_fips) |>
  rename(cvap_2012 = CVAP_EST_2012,
         cvap_2016 = CVAP_EST_2016,
         cvap_2020 = cvap_est) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("_"),
    names_to = c(".value", "year"),
    names_sep = "_") |>
  rename(turnout = total.CVAP) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year),
         pct_gop = gop/total) |>
  select(pct_gop, turnout, fips, year)

cvap = rbind(cvap, 
             cvap |> mutate(year = year +1),
             cvap |> mutate(year = year +2),
             cvap |> mutate(year = year +3)) #may be a more elegant way to do this but it works

irs_data = irs_data |>
  left_join(cvap |> rename(receiver_FIPS = fips, receiver_gop = pct_gop, receiver_turnout = turnout), by = join_by(year, receiver_FIPS))

irs_data = irs_data |>
  left_join(cvap |> rename(sender_FIPS = fips, sender_gop = pct_gop, sender_turnout = turnout), by = join_by(year, sender_FIPS))
```

```{r}
clean_donations <- function(df){
  YEAR = max(df$YEAR)
  
  df <- df |>
    unique() |>
  mutate(fips = sprintf("%05d",FIPS_STRING)) |>
  select(total_donations, fips) |>
    group_by(fips) |>
    summarize(donations = sum(total_donations)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(year = YEAR)
  
  df = rbind(df, df |> mutate(year = year - 1))
  
  return(df)
}

donation_data = NULL
for(election in c(2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022)){
  df = read.csv(paste0(datapath, "fec_summary_cleaned_",election-1,"_",election,".csv"))
  df = clean_donations(df)
  donation_data = rbind(donation_data, df)
}

cpi = read.csv(paste0(datapath, "cpi.csv"))
#2024 dollars, from FRED
#https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL#

colnames(cpi) = c("year", "cpi")

cpi <- cpi |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(str_sub(year, 0, 4)))

donation_data <- donation_data |>
  left_join(cpi) |>
  mutate(donations = donations / (cpi/100))

irs_data = irs_data |>
  left_join(donation_data |> rename(sender_FIPS = fips, sender_donations = donations), by = join_by(year, sender_FIPS))

irs_data = irs_data |>
  left_join(donation_data |> rename(receiver_FIPS = fips, receiver_donations = donations), join_by(year, receiver_FIPS))

irs_data = irs_data |>
  mutate(scaled_turnout = sender_gop*sender_turnout - receiver_gop*receiver_turnout,
         scaled_donations = sender_gop*log(1+(sender_donations/sender_pop)) - receiver_gop*log(1+(receiver_donations/receiver_pop)),
         partisan_gap = sender_gop - receiver_gop,
         generalelection = if_else(year %% 4 %in% c(0,3), T, F))
```

```{r}
library(stargazer)
model1 = lm(log(people_flow) ~ log(sender_density)*log(receiver_density) + log(sender_pop) + log(receiver_pop) + instate*poly(log(dist),3)  + as.factor(year), data = irs_data)
# as.factor(uic_receiver)*as.factor(uic_sender)

# model = lm(log(people_flow) ~ log(sender_pop) + log(receiver_pop) + poly(log(1+dist),4) + instate, data = irs_data)
summary(model1)
```

```{r}
library(stargazer)
model2 = lm(log(people_flow) ~ log(sender_density)*log(receiver_density) + log(sender_pop) + log(receiver_pop) + instate*poly(log(dist),3)  + as.factor(year) + partisan_gap + scaled_turnout + scaled_donations, data = irs_data)
# as.factor(uic_receiver)*as.factor(uic_sender)

# model = lm(log(people_flow) ~ log(sender_pop) + log(receiver_pop) + poly(log(1+dist),4) + instate, data = irs_data)
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
#regression table for report
stargazer(model1, model2,
        omit = "factor\\(year\\)",
        add.lines = list(c("Year Fixed Effects", "Yes", "Yes")))
```

```{r}
irs_data$fitted = exp(predict(model, irs_data))

irs_data <- irs_data |>
  mutate(residual = log(people_flow) - log(fitted))

#all of the lowest residuals are in virginia, likely due to very low dist for cities within counties
```
